mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining below 0.15 over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not decrease consistently over the prior month, or 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate crosses above 4%, signaling monetary tightening, it raises borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4% in the prior month, or the crossing is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in personal consumption (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic growth, enhancing corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases 2% and INDPRO increases 1% in the same month
failure_condition: The combined effect of GDPC1 and INDPRO does not result in statistically significant positive 60-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05), or the increases are not concurrent.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5%, signaling labor market weakness, it reduces consumer spending and corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE exceeding 5% in the prior month, or the crossing is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate amplifies discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS rising in the prior month within the tightening regime, or the rise is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in personal consumption (GDPC1) signal a robust labor market and strong demand, enhancing corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases 2% and UNRATE decreases 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: The combined effect of GDPC1 and UNRATE does not result in statistically significant positive 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05), or the changes are not concurrent.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95, indicating supply contraction, it reduces corporate profits and consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive despite INDPRO falling below 95 in the prior month, or the crossing is not sustained.
